record_title: Character-degree polynomials for graphical groups from even-cycle-free graphs and cycles
provenance: Scientific theorem, proof, literature comparison, and review evidence only.
limitations: The formulas are stated for odd q.
The result does not assert character-degree polynomiality for arbitrary graphical groups.
The even-cycle correction is proved for cycle graphs and is not claimed for general unicyclic graphs with attached trees.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge; an unindexed or differently phrased prior application could exist.
